1) When you say "what's stored" — does Redwood persist the raw prompt inputs, the generated outputs, or derived logs (e.g., request metadata, logs for debugging)? For the PoC we'll be sending anonymized transaction summaries but compliance wants to be explicit.

Hi Olivia — quick technical answers below (happy to jump on a 20-min call if useful):

1) What we persist by default (hosted Redwood API):
   - Prompts (request payloads): by default, stored for 30 days for debugging/quality. They are NOT used to train models.
   - Outputs (model responses): also stored for 30 days by default.
   - Request metadata / logs (timestamps, latency, token counts, routing decisions): stored for 90 days by default for observability.

2) Residence & replication:
   - For our hosted offering (what we demo’d), persisted artifacts are stored in the region you select at account setup (we can provision in us-west-2 for this PoC). Cross-region replication is OFF by default; backups are encrypted and stored in the same region unless explicitly enabled by the customer.

3) Retention & opt-out:
   - Defaults above (30/30/90) are configurable at the account or route level for enterprise customers. For Dedicated/Private deployments you can set retention to 0 (no persistence) or an SLA-backed custom policy.
   - For the PoC we can: a) lower retention to 7 days, b) disable storing prompt inputs/outputs entirely and only store aggregated telemetry, or c) run the PoC on a Dedicated pool with a 0-day retention setting. Please confirm which you prefer.

4) Redaction & hashing:
   - We provide a pre-ingest redaction SDK that can be run client-side (recommended) to remove/hide PII before hitting our API.
   - We also have server-side masking rules that can be applied to routes but that requires account-level configuration and review.

5) Encryption & KMS:
   - TLS for transit; AES-256 at rest.
   - Customer-managed keys (KMS) supported on Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted accounts can use customer-managed keys for an extra enterprise add-on.

6) Audit & access controls:
   - Audit logs and role-based access controls available. We support SSO (SAML/OIDC) and integration with your enterprise IAM.

References & attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (attached), data_retention_matrix.xlsx (attached), privacy FAQ: https://www.redwood.com/privacy#data-retention
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-987654
